payout_value_note: Flat $50 to the referrer and $50 to the referee. Referrer capped at $500/year (10 max).
payout_quote: When they qualify*, you'll both earn $50! ... Refer as many friends as you want, and earn up to $500 a year.
steps: Referrer logs into the Wellby Mobile App or online banking to get a personalized referral code.
Friend opens a new Wellby Secure Spending checking account using the referral code.

For three full calendar months, the new account must: remain open and in good standing, maintain a positive average daily balance, and receive recurring direct deposits totaling at least $500 each calendar month.
Bonuses paid on the fifth business day of the month following qualification.
catches: The new account must receive $500+ in recurring direct deposits for THREE full calendar months — payout takes ~4 months.
Bonuses reported as interest income on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Offer may not be combined with other promotions; subject to change/termination without notice.
Existing members must not have had a prior Wellby checking account; no self-referrals.
biggest_catch: Capped at $500/year, and the friend must hit $500+/month in direct deposits for three full calendar months — the $50 arrives roughly four months in.
eligibility: Wellby Financial membership; friend must open a new Secure Spending account (no prior Wellby checking).
timing: Code sharing ~5 min active; bonus paid on the 5th business day of the month following qualification.
